# BenchmarkVideoSpool (internal/app/videospool_bench_test.go): memory (old) vs spool (new),
# each of 10 runs per variant in its own process (peak RSS is per process), gpl builder, arm64.
# Raw runs: go test -c, then app.test -test.bench 'VideoSpool/<variant>$' -test.benchtime 3x -test.benchmem, x10.

goos: linux
goarch: arm64
pkg: github.com/xantiagoma/xtandard-image/internal/app
